label: The sustaining sibling of esse dependence, from contact and co-presence
description: New non-transcription conditional derivation. Let c, distinct from x, cause x's esse and sustain x in every history in which x is present. For any history v and moment t with x present, c gives x being at t (SustainsBeing), so c is present at t (contact c4661518). Hence c is present whenever x is, in every history, and the co-presence bridge gives that x depends for its being on c. Each premise is needed in a checked interpretation: the bridge (Control part 2, dependence empty) and contact (part 3, an absent giver); both hold with the conclusion nonvacuously (part 4). Both premises stay OPEN. No premise is established.
